shared_pair_architecture.pair_combination: concat[ a, b, a*b, abs(a-b) ]  where a=enc(host), b=enc(guest)

smoke1_pure_torch_GIN._note: the first/lighter GNN used in suprabench_smoke1_gnn.py (no PyG dependency); reports double-cold R2~0.258
smoke1_pure_torch_GIN.aggregation: index_add over edges with learnable eps per layer ((1+eps)*h + sum_neighbors)

training.val_size: GINE/AFP: max(20, int(0.15*len(train)));  smoke1-GIN: max(30, int(0.15*len(train)))
training.y_standardization: per-train-fold mu,sd (computed on the training portion only)

_meta_from_canonical_run.gnn_seed_variance: suprabench_sim_null.py P4 ran 5 model-seeds x 12 double-cold folds (L214-222)
